> Last updated: 2026-07-29

# REPLy.jl — Documentation Index

> A network REPL server for Julia. Exposes a Julia session over a socket-based protocol (newline-delimited JSON), allowing editors, IDEs, and other tooling to connect, evaluate code, and inspect results interactively.

## Entry Points

- **Landing / Quick Start** — docs/src/index.md
- **API Reference** — docs/src/api.md (rendered via Documenter.jl; run `just docs-build` to generate)
- **Protocol Reference** — docs/src/reference-protocol.md
- **Development Methodology** — docs/src/methodology.md
- **Status & Spec Conformance** — docs/src/status.md
